grid.layout_notes: 5-reel 4-4-4-4-4 setup that can expand to 5-5-5-5-5 (The Ride / Last Ride add a row → 5×5).

win_system.notes: Sheet describes paytable and win ways (ways product of symbol heights). Exact base ways count not printed as a single integer.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works: Winning combinations are destroyed and remaining symbols tumble down; new symbols fall in. Continues with avalanches; Charged Wilds interact with Gas Can fuel across avalanches.

expanding_reels.how_it_works: Bonus modes add a row (4-high → 5-high / 5×5). Chainsaw Larry Spins add an extra enhancer reel.

other.name: Burnout
other.how_it_works: Exactly 2 Scatters on the same row: after wins, destroy all symbols including the 2 Scatters and tumble new symbols in.

other.name: Charged Wild / Gas Can
other.how_it_works: When Charged Wild is part of a win, it spends a Gas Can charge and doubles its multiplier for the next avalanche until gas is empty.

wilds.name: Charged Wild
wilds.behavior: On reels 2–5. When part of a win, reduces Gas Can fuel by a charge and doubles its multiplier for the next avalanche until gas empty. During The Ride, can go up to 4× before destroyed.

wilds.name: Chainsaw Larry Wild
wilds.behavior: Appears only in Chainsaw Larry Spins as a jumping Wild on reels 2–4 each spin.

scatters.name: Scatter
scatters.behavior: Main game: only on reels 1, 3, and 5. Exactly 2 on same row → Burnout tumble. 3 on different rows → 8 spins The Ride. 3 on same row → 9 spins The Last Ride.

specials.name: xSplit (Chainsaw Larry Spins)
specials.behavior: Enhancer: doubles all multipliers between xSplit and Chainsaw Larry; each character symbol split increases win multiplier by +1.

specials.name: Smiley enhancer
specials.behavior: Awards +1 spin during Chainsaw Larry Spins.

specials.name: Lucky Feet enhancer
specials.behavior: Moves Chainsaw Larry to a different row/position on reels 2–4, leaving a regular Wild. Landing on Charged Wild triggers Afterburner (doubles symbol multipliers on that row; if on initial Charged Wild, all symbols become x2).

base_game_loop.summary: Paid spin on 4-4-4-4-4 ways grid with tumbles. Wilds/Charged Wilds on reels 2–5; Charged Wilds spend Gas Can charges to double multipliers across avalanches. Scatters on 1/3/5: 2 same-row → Burnout full clear; 3 different rows → The Ride (8); 3 same row → The Last Ride (9). During rides, 3 scatters add +3 spins and enter Chainsaw Larry Spins.

phases.name: Spin
phases.what_happens: Reels stop on 4-4-4-4-4. Evaluate ways wins.

phases.name: Tumble / avalanche
phases.what_happens: Destroy winning symbols; tumble down; refill. Charged Wild in a win spends Gas Can charge and doubles its multiplier for next avalanche until empty.
phases.state_changes: Gas Can charges may deplete; Charged Wild multipliers update

phases.name: Burnout check
phases.what_happens: If exactly 2 Scatters landed on the same row, after wins destroy all symbols including those Scatters and tumble refill.

phases.name: Bonus trigger
phases.what_happens: 3 Scatters different rows → 8 The Ride. 3 Scatters same row → 9 The Last Ride (guaranteed Scatter on reel 5 during Last Ride).
phases.state_changes: Grid expands to 5×5 in ride modes

base_game_loop.win_evaluation: Ways wins paid each tumble step; Charged Wild multipliers apply across avalanches via Gas Can.
base_game_loop.notes: From official Kiss My Chainsaw game sheet feature pages + CMS feature blurbs.

modes.name: The Ride
modes.trigger: 3 Scatter symbols on different rows (main game scatters on reels 1,3,5).
modes.retrigger: Exactly 2 Scatters award +1 spin (same-row pair also triggers Burnout). 3 Scatters award +3 spins and activate Chainsaw Larry Spins.
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Extra row added → 5×5. Charged Wilds can go up to 4× before destroyed.
modes.end_condition: Spins exhausted (or End of the Road 10,900× cap).

phases.name: Expand
phases.what_happens: Add a row; play on 5×5 with Charged Wild cap 4×.

phases.name: Spin loop
phases.what_happens: Tumble play; 2 scatters +1 spin; 3 scatters +3 and enter Chainsaw Larry Spins.

modes.effects: 8 FS on 5×5; Charged Wilds up to 4×; retriggers as above; can enter Chainsaw Larry Spins.

modes.name: The Last Ride
modes.trigger: 3 Scatter symbols on the same row.
modes.retrigger: Same as The Ride; 3 Scatters award +3 and activate Chainsaw Larry Spins.
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Same as The Ride plus guaranteed Scatter on reel 5.

phases.name: Enter Last Ride
phases.what_happens: Play The Ride rules with guaranteed Scatter on reel 5 for 9 spins.

modes.effects: 9 FS; The Ride rules + guaranteed Scatter on reel 5.

modes.name: Chainsaw Larry Spins
modes.trigger: Land 3 Scatter symbols during The Ride or The Last Ride.
modes.spins_awarded: +3 spins on activation (added to the ride).
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Extra enhancer reel added; upgraded Chainsaw Larry Spins paytable. Jumping Chainsaw Larry Wild on reels 2–4 each spin.
modes.progressive_state: Jumping onto character symbols +1 win multiplier. xSplit doubles multipliers between xSplit and Larry and +1 per character split. Afterburner can double row (or all-symbol x2) multipliers.
modes.end_condition: Ride/Larry spins complete or max-win cap.

phases.name: Activate Larry
phases.what_happens: Add enhancer reel; upgrade paytable; +3 spins.

phases.name: Jumping Wild + enhancers
phases.what_happens: Larry jumps on reels 2–4; reveals Smiley / xSplit / Lucky Feet on his row; character landings +1 mult.

modes.effects: Enhancer reel + jumping Larry Wild; Smiley/+1 spin, xSplit, Lucky Feet/Afterburner; character hits raise win multiplier.

features.name: Wilds & Charged Wilds
features.effects: Wilds on reels 2–5. Charged Wild in a win spends Gas Can charge and doubles its multiplier for next avalanche until empty.

features.name: Burnout
features.trigger: Exactly 2 Scatters on the same row
features.effects: Destroy all symbols including the 2 Scatters; tumble refill.

features.name: xSplit
features.effects: Double multipliers between xSplit and Chainsaw Larry; +1 win mult per character symbol split.

features.name: End of the Road
features.effects: Max payout 10,900× base bet; round ends and awards the cap.

## Scatter
In the main game, the Scatter symbol can only land on reel 1,3, and 5.
Burnout is triggered by landing exactly 2 Scatter symbols, both on the same row.
Once all winnings are executed, Burnout will destroy all symbols including the 2 Scatter symbols, allowing new symbols to fall in.
Depending on what row the Scatter symbols land on, one of the bonus modes will be awarded.
- 3 Scatter symbols on different rows: Activates 8 spins of "The Ride".
- 3 Scatter symbols on the same row: Activates 9 spins of "The Last Ride".

## The Ride
An extra row is added and the reel area becomes 5x5.
During 'The Ride' Spins, Charged WIlds can go up to 4x before it gets destroyed.
Landing exactly 2 Scatter Symbols awards +1 spin. If there are only 2 Scatter symbols on the same row, Burnout is triggered.
Landing 3 Scatter symbols will award +3 spins and activate Chainsaw Larry spins.

## The Last Ride
Gameplay and features from "The Ride" are the same, but with a guaranteed Scatter symbol on reel 5.
Landing 3 Scatter symbols will award +3 spins and activate Chainsaw Larry spins.
